summary: Full re-test of SplitsPro after ground-up luxury redesign. Backend 8/8 pytest tests pass: /api/quotes create+list+validation (empty body, short phone, blank name all -> 422), /api/reviews returns 8 Western Sydney-seeded reviews (SEED_VERSION=2 re-seed confirmed - no Bondi/Manly/Cronulla). Frontend 62/62 checks pass across 3 playwright runs: editorial hero headline 'Crafted Comfort For Every Home' with in-hero quote panel and HERO_TRUST points (Licensed & Insured, Premium Installation Workmanship, Manufacturer Warranty, Western Sydney Specialists), quote form empty-submit shows error toast (no success), filled submit via shadcn Select shows quote-success, all 12 routes render without runtime/pageerror, new nav labels (Home/Split Systems/Ducted/Cleaning/Gallery/Service Areas/About/Contact + Get Quote btn) all present, nav-get-quote-btn -> /contact, floating-quote-btn appears after scrolling ~600px on desktop and links to /contact, mobile sticky-call-btn + sticky-quote-btn visible, mobile-menu-toggle opens menu, /service-areas lists all 10 Western Sydney suburbs and has areas-map iframe, /reviews shows 8 Western Sydney reviews, /faq accordion expands (aria-expanded false->true), before-after present on Home and Gallery, footer-map iframe present, phone 0414 698 435 + ABN 62 137 127 557 in footer. Business rules verified: NO email/mailto anywhere on /, /about, /contact, /reviews, /service-areas, /faq; NO fake stats/counters ('10+ years', '2500+', '5-star reviews', 'Happy Customers', 'Installations Completed', 'Projects Completed' all absent). Zero backend or frontend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is compact and clean (~160 lines). seed_reviews correctly uses db.meta version gating so re-runs are idempotent.
Home.jsx defines several sub-components in one file (~260 lines) — acceptable for a marketing page but could be split into /pages/home/*.jsx if it grows further.

QuoteForm client-side validation is duplicated by server-side Pydantic validators — that's fine (defence in depth). Consider surfacing server 422 field errors in the toast instead of a generic 'Something went wrong' if the API rejects a bad phone slipping past the client (currently client blocks empty phone but not <8-digit phone).
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via find projection {"_id": 0} in both list endpoints — good.
FloatingCTA scroll listener uses window.scrollY which is what Lenis proxies to — works correctly on this site.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST-prefixed quote leads (TEST Alice, TEST Bob, TEST Carol, TEST Persistence Check, TEST Playwright User) via /api/quotes during testing. Reviews DB was re-seeded by the backend itself via SEED_VERSION=2 on startup (verified in output).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything specified in the review request is verified working. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py). For frontend, use mouse.wheel (not window.scrollTo) because Lenis intercepts programmatic scrolls. Service-required field is a shadcn/radix Select — open with click on [data-testid=quote-service-select] then wait 400ms then click [role=option]. Reviews are re-seeded automatically on backend startup if db.meta.reviews_seed.version != SEED_VERSION.
rca of the issue: No issues found — iteration 2 is a clean pass.
